candidate.answerReason: The remaining 25% scored 100, giving a mean of 87. Both middle scores are 90, so the median is 90 and the difference is 3 points.

methods.label: Compute the weighted mean and locate the median
methods.explanation:
The percentage scoring \(100\) is
\[
100\%-10\%-35\%-30\%=25\%.
\]
Each score contributes to the mean according to the fraction of students receiving it. Therefore the mean is
\[
\begin{aligned}
&0.10(70)+0.35(80)+0.30(90)+0.25(100)\\
&\qquad=7+28+27+25=87.
\end{aligned}
\]
To locate the median precisely, note that \(35\%=\frac7{20}\), so the class size is \(20k\) for some positive integer \(k\). In increasing order, the first \(9k\) scores are \(70\) or \(80\), and positions \(9k+1\) through \(15k\) have score \(90\). The middle positions, \(10k\) and \(10k+1\), both lie in this group. Thus the median is \(90\).

The difference is \(90-87=\boxed{3}\) points, choice \(\mathrm{C}\).
